changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.catalog_collection_doc_owner(p_tenant text, p_collection text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ -- RDR-229 P3.5b: documents are read by physical_collection_id, through the registry row(s) that carry p_collection as their label. -- The registry INSERT branch is dead by design for a fresh label: the BEFORE INSERT trigger (catalog_collections_owner_from_docs) -- passes NEW.name before the new row exists, so no registry row holds the label, and a document can carry only the id of a row that -- already exists. The one way in is a label a tombstone (a superseded row of that name) still holds, whose documents the new row -- would read as the by-name read did; catalog_collections_pk (tenant_id, name) keeps a tombstone and a live row from sharing a name -- until P4.1 replaces it, so that cannot happen today (Rdr229P35bSqlReadersIntegrationTest pins both). SELECT o.seg FROM ( SELECT split_part(d.tumbler, '.', 1) || '-' || split_part(d.tumbler, '.', 2) AS seg, count(*) AS n FROM nexus.catalog_documents d JOIN nexus.catalog_collections cc ON cc.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND cc.collection_id = d.physical_collection_id WHERE d.tenant_id = p_tenant AND cc.name = p_collection AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.tumbler ~ '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' GROUP BY 1 ) o ORDER BY (NOT nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(p_tenant, o.seg)) DESC, o.n DESC, o.seg LIMIT 1 $fn$;

changeSet.comment: RDR-229 P3.5b form A (nexus-p2m1x.24): CONTINUE-gated on every stamp label being complete as CompletionCheck counts it (the gate is described in the file header), so it is skipped unrecorded and retried at every boot until then. nexus.topics_with_counts reports the registry's label of the topic's collection_id as collection (a left join on catalog_collections, '' where the topic has no collection, as its name column read), so the view reads no topics name column and survives P4.1's DROP COLUMN ... CASCADE. Same columns, names, types and order. Replaces the view of catalog-009-read-shape-views.xml, changeset catalog-009-5 (line 138), the last definer; its option and its grant are kept. DATA EFFECT: none, a view definition only.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.topics_with_counts WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT t.tenant_id, t.id, t.label, t.parent_id, COALESCE(cc.name, '') AS collection, t.centroid_hash, t.doc_count, t.created_at, t.review_status, t.terms FROM nexus.topics t LEFT JOIN nexus.catalog_collections cc ON cc.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND cc.collection_id = t.collection_id
